clauses.scope_note: User Service Agreement, § 用户的权利与义务, 3. Prohibition on dissemination of harmful information; applies to using Baidu Intelligent Cloud services for the specified dissemination.
clauses.condition_explanation: The ban concerns dissemination through the service of large quantities of unsolicited email, electronic advertising, or email containing harmful information.

obligation_items.content: Do not use the service to disseminate large volumes of unsolicited email or electronic advertising, or email containing harmful information.
obligation_items.object: Baidu Intelligent Cloud service and messages disseminated through it
obligation_items.trigger: When using the service to disseminate large volumes of unsolicited email or electronic advertising, or email containing harmful information.

clauses.scope_note: User Service Agreement, § 用户的权利与义务, 3.1; covers use of communication services to send the listed messages.
clauses.condition_explanation: The listed messages include surveys, contests, pyramid schemes, chain letters, spam, and any duplicative or proactively offered messages, for commercial or other purposes.

obligation_items.content: Do not use a communication service to send surveys, contests, pyramid schemes, chain letters, spam, or duplicative or proactively offered messages.
obligation_items.object: Communication service and messages sent through it
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever using a communication service to send the listed messages, whether for commercial or other purposes.

clauses.scope_note: User Service Agreement, § 用户的权利与义务, 3.2; examples of affected legal rights include privacy and publicity rights.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition covers defamation, abuse, harassment, intimidation, threats, and other conduct infringing another person's legal rights, including privacy or publicity rights.

obligation_items.content: Do not use the service to defame, abuse, harass, intimidate, or threaten another person, or otherwise infringe another person's legal rights.
obligation_items.object: Baidu Intelligent Cloud service and affected persons' legal rights
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever using the service to engage in the specified conduct.

clauses.scope_note: User Service Agreement, § 用户的权利与义务, 3.3; the text also names publishing, posting, and uploading.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibited subject matter includes inappropriate, profane, defamatory, obscene, vulgar, or otherwise illegal topics, names, materials, or information; the specified conduct includes publishing, posting, uploading, distributing, or disseminating.

obligation_items.content: Do not publish, post, upload, distribute, or disseminate inappropriate, profane, defamatory, obscene, vulgar, or otherwise illegal topics, names, materials, or information.
obligation_items.object: Material or information published or distributed through the service
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever publishing, posting, uploading, distributing, or disseminating the listed subject matter through the service.

clauses.scope_note: User Service Agreement, § 用户的权利与义务, 3.4; applies to uploading or otherwise providing files containing protected material, subject to the stated rights exception.
clauses.condition_explanation: The restriction applies to files containing images, photographs, software, or other material protected by intellectual-property, privacy, or publicity rights. It does not apply when the user owns or controls the relevant rights, or has obtained all necessary permissions.

obligation_items.content: Do not upload or otherwise provide files containing material protected by intellectual-property, privacy, or publicity rights unless you own or control the relevant rights or have obtained all necessary permissions.
obligation_items.object: Files containing protected images, photographs, software, or other material
obligation_items.trigger: When uploading or otherwise providing such files, unless the user owns or controls the relevant rights or has obtained all necessary permissions.

clauses.scope_note: User Service Agreement, § 用户的权利与义务, 3.5; concerns material or information obtained through the service, including images and photographs.
clauses.condition_explanation: Proprietary rights expressly include copyright, trademark, patent, trade secret, and other proprietary rights.

obligation_items.content: Do not use material or information obtained through the service in a way that infringes another party's copyright, trademark, patent, trade secret, or other proprietary right.
obligation_items.object: Materials or information obtained through the service
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever using material or information obtained through the service.

clauses.scope_note: User Service Agreement, § 用户的权利与义务, 3.6; concerns uploading software or programs containing harmful components.
clauses.condition_explanation: Examples include viruses, Trojans, worms, time bombs, cancelbots, and corrupted files; the ban also covers similar software or programs that may damage another person's computer or assets.

obligation_items.content: Do not upload software or programs containing viruses, Trojans, worms, time bombs, cancelbots, corrupted files, or similar components that may damage others' computers or assets.
obligation_items.object: Software or programs uploaded through the service
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever uploading software or programs containing such components or otherwise capable of the specified damage.

clauses.scope_note: User Service Agreement, § 用户的权利与义务, 3.7; concerns commercial advertising or proposals to sell or purchase goods or services through a communication service.
clauses.condition_explanation: Commercial advertising and proposals to sell or purchase goods or services are prohibited unless the communication service expressly allows the message.

obligation_items.content: Do not send commercial advertising or proposals to sell or purchase goods or services through a communication service unless that service expressly allows the message.
obligation_items.object: Commercial advertising or sale/purchase messages sent through the communication service
obligation_items.trigger: When sending such a commercial message, except when the communication service expressly allows it.

clauses.scope_note: User Service Agreement, § 用户的权利与义务, 3.8; concerns downloading a file posted by another communication-service user.
clauses.condition_explanation: The restriction applies when the user knows or reasonably should know that copying, displaying, performing, or distributing the file in that manner would be illegal.

obligation_items.content: Do not download another communication-service user's file when you know or reasonably should know that copying, displaying, performing, or distributing it in that manner would be illegal.
obligation_items.object: File posted by another communication-service user
obligation_items.trigger: When downloading the file and the user knows or reasonably should know that the specified copying, display, performance, or distribution would be illegal.

clauses.scope_note: User Service Agreement, § 用户的权利与义务, 3.9; applies to rights-management and source or provenance information contained in uploaded files.
clauses.condition_explanation: Examples include author attribution, legal notices, proprietary marks, and source or provenance labels.

obligation_items.content: Do not falsify or delete copyright-management information, including author attribution, legal notices, proprietary marks, or source or provenance labels contained in uploaded files.
obligation_items.object: Copyright-management and source-identification information in uploaded files
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever handling such information in an uploaded file.

clauses.scope_note: User Service Agreement, § 用户的权利与义务, 3.10; concerns other people's information, including email addresses.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition covers obtaining or otherwise collecting other people's information; email addresses are an express example.

obligation_items.content: Do not obtain or otherwise collect other people's information, including email addresses.
obligation_items.trigger: Whenever obtaining or collecting information about other people.
